name: direct left open
speaker: Cole
line: Cole at the Lot, south dock. direct left open. 6 steps. The drum stays for the hold.

speaker: Ada
line: Ada: Hold the drum at the Lot. Nobody past the south dock. We hold in 7 steps. Direct on the left lane, open.

name: the Lot south dock
speaker: Bess
line: the Lot south dock. Bess keeps the drum for the hold. 8 steps, direct on the left lane, open.
